title: The agent's runtime settings
description: What the agent may spend on one proposal, and which model it is. A sixth family rather than a corner of design/: design/ is read by the engine that decides whether an experiment may exist, and the agent is one of three sources that hand that engine a form -- a ceiling on the agent's spend is not a property of any design. Every entry is a {value, source} pair; nothing here is law, so every source is a scenario_assumption whose note carries the measurement the value was set from. A model id is here for a second reason: the recording claim 6 grades is stamped with it, and a model nobody can name is a proposer from nobody.

ceilings.description: Hitting any ceiling produces no proposal and a named failure, never a truncated design.

tokens_per_proposal.description: Output tokens across every model call one question makes.

seconds_per_proposal.description: Wall clock for one question, end to end.

tool_calls_per_proposal.description: Metric-tool calls one question may make before delivering. The delivery itself is not counted.

proposer.description: Which model, where, and through which of Bedrock's two endpoints.

model_id.description: The id as the endpoint takes it, inference-profile prefix included where one is needed.

region.description: The AWS region the model is invoked in.

legacy_endpoint.description: true for an ARN-versioned id served by the InvokeModel path; false for a bare id served by the Messages-API endpoint.
